# SimiRouter — Full documentation (en)

> SimiRouter — Machine-readable documentation index.

## API quick reference
- Base URL: https://api.dwchainless.com
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`
- Main endpoints:
  - `POST /v1/chat/completions` — Chat Completions
  - `POST /v1/responses` — Responses
  - `POST /v1/messages` — Claude Messages
  - `POST /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent` — Gemini
  - `GET /v1/models` — Models

## Preferred sources
- [Full documentation](https://simirouter.github.io/simidoc/en/llms-full.txt): Full documentation in one file.
